These fixtures derive from a retained prior independent review export. The original export placed TextAnnotation artifacts before its SequenceFlow, which violates BPMN Process child order. The derived fixtures move that existing SequenceFlow before the artifacts. The original also placed vendor v:mark attributes on dc:Point, whose official schema permits only x/y; each value is retained as v:pointNMark on its owning BPMNEdge, while the point comment/PI sentinels stay in place. IDs, references, coordinates, remaining vendor payloads and QName bindings are unchanged. The visible variant adds DI for the two Association dependencies. Both baseline fixtures and all fresh mutation exports are validated with the official BPMN XSD. These are evidence for the newly reconstructed flow implementation, not recovered d75 source or prior acceptance counts. The audit extension declares semantic references; vendor payloads remain opaque.
